Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of AON.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $7.98 per share.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 11% to 22% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2022.
Operating income reached $8.3 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. Our cloud segment grew 11% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Second question - Analyst:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
